frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Mother Board, it's good to see you online again.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: Thank you, traveller. Your efforts have restored the beat to Electronova. You have awakened us from our silence and brought back our rhythm.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: The techno power resurgence is now in full effect. The Grand Composer's influence will be purged from our systems.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: As a token of gratitude, I will assist you in repairing your ship. Also, take this Celestial Amp to aid you on your journey.

frames.heading: You received a Celestial Amp!
frames.body: Forged from advanced alloys and intricate circuitry, the Celestial Amp of Electronova amplifies beats with the planet's powerful techno rhythms. This futuristic amplifier transforms simple tunes into grand electronic symphonies, connecting the music to the very core of Electronova's technological essence.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Mother Board. You've been a big help.

frames.heading: Mother Board
frames.body: Your journey is far from over, traveller. Beyond the waves lies Ampliforia, home to the rock gods. They, too, may need your aid.
